HTTP client for fetching genesis.tar.bz2 from peers with poll-based I/O and SHA-256 check.

# Purpose
This file implements a client for fetching a genesis archive from one or more HTTP entrypoint servers. It defines the `fd_genesis_client_t` object lifecycle with [`fd_genesis_client_align`](<#fd_genesis_client_align>), [`fd_genesis_client_footprint`](<#fd_genesis_client_footprint>), [`fd_genesis_client_new`](<#fd_genesis_client_new>), and [`fd_genesis_client_join`](<#fd_genesis_client_join>), which manage placement in shared memory and validate the object with a magic value. The [`fd_genesis_client_init`](<#fd_genesis_client_init>) function opens nonblocking TCP sockets to the configured servers, stores each socket in a `pollfd` array, and prepares per-peer state for request and response handling.

The main work happens in [`fd_genesis_client_poll`](<#fd_genesis_client_poll>), which drives all connections with `poll`, sends an HTTP `GET /genesis.tar.bz2` request, reads each response, parses the HTTP status and headers with `picohttpparser`, checks for `200 OK`, extracts `Content-Length`, and copies the response body into a buffer. It also computes a SHA-256 hash of the received body with `fd_sha256_hash`. The file includes helper functions to close sockets, parse `Content-Length`, and expose the internal `pollfd` array through [`fd_genesis_client_get_pollfds`](<#fd_genesis_client_get_pollfds>), so other code can integrate this client into an event loop.
